name: radix-checkbox
title: Radix Checkbox
description: An accessible, stylable checkbox built on Radix UI with a Motion-friendly animated indicator.

agentMetadata.intent: Toggle an independent boolean setting with Radix state semantics.
a11yConstraints: Preserve the checkbox role, label association, and keyboard toggling.
agentMetadata.motionEngine: Motion checkmark and scale feedback synchronized with checked state.
compositionRules: Pair with a visible label and explicit form submission semantics.
compositionRecipes: Compose with radix/button in a preference form.
